name: prestashopheaven/build-prestashop-index
description: The PrestaShop index per release: classes, methods, constants, deprecations, hooks, services, configuration keys, tables and shipped vendor packages, with a search (ps-module ps find) and a check of a module against every release in its range (ps-module ps check).

prestashopheaven.use-when: Before using or writing PrestaShop code: does PrestaShop already have it and in which releases (ps-module ps find "<term>"); and to check that every PrestaShop class, method, constant and hook a module uses exists in every release of its range (ps-module ps check).
